143.value: Only I and II are correct
143.reasoning: Statement I is correct: wind is air moving from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure. Statement II follows the school textbook's description of wind by its two features, its speed and its direction; NTA's final key counts it as correct. Statement III is wrong: a hygrometer measures humidity, while a wind vane shows the direction of the wind. So statements I and II are taken as correct, which is option (3).
